title: Sango, Riverain | Ethnologue Free
text: Riverain Sango is a stable indigenous language of the Central African Republic. It is a Ngbandi-based creole. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
